thesis: Substantially a capacity contract with a trading option: resource adequacy carries most revenue and credits exactly four hours. At build cost the reference project returns 3.2%, so buy operating RA-contracted assets only at a price that clears the hurdle, after the 2027 foldback cut.
本质上是附带交易选择权的容量合同：资源充裕度贡献大部分收入，且恰好按四小时计量。按建设成本测算参考项目回报为3.2%，因此只在2027年出力回落下调之后、以达到回报门槛的价格收购持有资源充裕度合同的在运资产。

reason: Ninth of fifteen markets on hold IRR, 3.2%.
持有期IRR为3.2%，在十五个市场中排第九。

reason: 78% of first-year revenue is secured for ten years under a resource adequacy contract; such contracts are bilateral and their prices are not public.

reason: About 0.4% of project cost falls with the interconnection request, and two-thirds of it is a readiness deposit posted before the cluster study says what the project will be assigned; it is then topped up to 5% of the assigned network upgrade cost.
约占项目投资0.4%的款项须随并网申请缴纳，其中三分之二是商业成熟度保证金，须在集群研究给出分摊结果之前提交；此后还须补足至所分摊电网升级费用的5%。

reason: The tariff publishes the application window, the fees and deposits, the site-control test and the withdrawal penalty; what a project is finally assigned depends on the cluster study.

approvalTransparency.author: analyst

reason: Review of foreign investment is largely voluntary and mandatory only in some cases, such as a foreign government taking a substantial interest; a notice is reviewed in 45 days, with a 45-day investigation if needed.
外资审查以自愿申报为主，仅在部分情形下（如外国政府取得重大权益）为强制申报；正式申报的审查期为45日，必要时再进行45日的调查。
